method: corpus-blind controlled generator; 38 practical/natural/physical cross-domain cases

cases.knowledge_need: How to keep a fresh-split ash handle from loosening in an iron hoe eye as it dries.
cases.circumstances: handle was fitted after rain and now rattles
cases.situation: A morning of digging remains before the plot can be planted.

cases.knowledge_need: Whether damp linen can be safely dried close to a clay stove without scorching or shrinking it.
cases.circumstances: cold rain has kept lines wet for two days
cases.situation: She needs a clean shirt for a traveller leaving at dawn.

cases.knowledge_need: How wind-driven rain reaches a thatched roof ridge and what temporary repair will hold until dry weather.
cases.circumstances: a gust lifted old thatch at the ridge
cases.situation: Water is dripping into a grain chest below.

cases.knowledge_need: Why a barrel of salted fish smells sour and whether its brine level can still protect the catch.
cases.circumstances: barrel stood in spring warmth after a bung leaked
cases.situation: He must decide what can be kept apart from what should not be served.

cases.knowledge_need: How to free a loaded cart wheel sunk in thawing ruts without breaking its spokes.
cases.circumstances: one horse is pulling while the wheel is buried to its hub
cases.situation: A second cart is approaching from behind.

cases.knowledge_need: How to recognize chafing beneath a horse collar and reduce it before a long haul.
cases.circumstances: the mare keeps tossing her head after harnessing
cases.situation: The owner wants to leave before sunset.

cases.knowledge_need: Whether willow bark cut in early spring will peel cleanly enough for simple binding strips.
cases.location: wet bank near an alder stand
cases.circumstances: fresh shoots are swelling but leaves are not open
cases.situation: She needs ties for several damaged baskets.

cases.knowledge_need: How to handle a shallow axe cut on a palm that is dirty with bark and soil.
cases.circumstances: cut bleeds steadily but fingers still move
cases.situation: He is far from town and must not contaminate the wound further.

cases.knowledge_need: How a sudden hard night frost affects newly sprouted peas in low ground.
cases.circumstances: clear evening follows a warm April day
cases.situation: He has loose straw and woven mats but little time before dark.

cases.knowledge_need: How to judge changing ice near a river current when crossing with a hand sled.
cases.circumstances: surface is snow-covered after several thawing days
cases.situation: A longer route to the bridge remains open.

cases.knowledge_need: Why smoke stays low in a hut during a damp, windless morning and how to improve breathing without spreading fire.
cases.circumstances: green kindling was used after overnight rain
cases.situation: Two children are coughing near the sleeping bench.

cases.knowledge_need: How to respond when wet wool mittens freeze stiff during winter travel.
cases.circumstances: snow entered his sleeves while he fell beside the road
cases.situation: He has a fire kit but wind is strong and daylight is short.

cases.knowledge_need: Why a clay-and-sand patch cracks around a hearth opening and how moisture and heat affect it.
cases.circumstances: patch was laid thick over damp old clay
cases.situation: The oven is needed for bread the next day.

cases.knowledge_need: How to clear a wooden bucket's rope from a well windlass after it twists under load.
cases.circumstances: bucket hangs halfway down and rope is pinched at the axle
cases.situation: A queue has formed with empty pails.

cases.knowledge_need: How standing water after snowmelt changes a kitchen-garden bed and what simple drainage is useful.
cases.location: low yard behind a timber house
cases.circumstances: meltwater has covered last year's manure
cases.situation: Seed potatoes must be planted soon.

cases.knowledge_need: How to tell whether a heated iron rivet has been upset enough to hold two strap ends without splitting them.
cases.circumstances: strap is for a chest hinge and rivet head is cooling quickly
cases.situation: The helper has only a hammer and anvil.

cases.knowledge_need: How to soften a water-soaked leather boot enough to reshape it without cracking when it dries.
cases.circumstances: boot was submerged while stepping from a boat
cases.situation: He must walk to market the next morning.

cases.knowledge_need: Why a hand quern begins producing coarse flour and how grain moisture and stone setting affect it.
cases.circumstances: grain was brought in from a humid store
cases.situation: She needs flour for evening porridge.

cases.knowledge_need: Why a crock of cabbage brine has stopped bubbling in a cold cellar and whether warmth should be changed gradually.
cases.circumstances: a cold snap followed packing the crock
cases.situation: The stored vegetables are meant for late winter.

cases.knowledge_need: How a small river boat behaves when a pole slips from firm bottom into soft silt near shore.
cases.circumstances: boat is carrying two passengers and sacks of rye
cases.situation: A crosswind is pushing its bow toward reeds.

cases.knowledge_need: How to approach a tethered cow that has become agitated after a dog barked nearby.
cases.circumstances: rope is caught around a sapling and cow is pulling against it
cases.situation: Milk pail and calf are both close by.

cases.knowledge_need: How reflected snow light and low winter sun affect a person trying to follow tracks.
cases.circumstances: wind has partly filled tracks with loose snow
cases.situation: He is deciding whether to continue before dusk.

cases.knowledge_need: What immediate care suits a minor scald from spilled hot porridge and when it may be more serious.
cases.circumstances: hot porridge splashed across a forearm
cases.situation: Skin is red and painful but not visibly charred.

cases.knowledge_need: How repeated loose stools after questionable well water affect a labourer's ability to work and what fluid care matters.
cases.circumstances: he feels weak after a day of summer heat
cases.situation: Companions need to decide whether he can remain at work.

cases.knowledge_need: Why a charcoal brazier flares when fresh fuel is piled on and how airflow changes the burn.
cases.circumstances: he needs a steady bed of heat for a small repair
cases.situation: Dry shavings lie near the brazier.

cases.knowledge_need: How a hemp rope's condition and knot placement affect lifting a heavy stone from a shallow pit.
cases.circumstances: rope is frayed near one end and stone is half buried
cases.situation: Three people can pull but no replacement rope is nearby.

cases.knowledge_need: How to reduce mice reaching a sack of grain stored in a timber room.
cases.circumstances: fresh droppings appear beneath the sack each morning
cases.situation: She has boards, a clay jar, and a cat that rarely hunts.

cases.knowledge_need: How cold, damp spring weather changes bee activity at a hollow-log hive and when opening it causes harm.
cases.circumstances: few bees are flying after three rainy days
cases.situation: He worries the colony has failed.

cases.knowledge_need: How to thaw a frozen pike without leaving the outer flesh warm too long in a heated room.
cases.circumstances: fish was kept outdoors through a hard freeze
cases.situation: Guests expect supper before nightfall.

cases.knowledge_need: How wind-packed snow differs from loose snow when making a temporary windbreak beside a forest road.
cases.circumstances: sleigh runner cracked and snow continues falling
cases.situation: Two people must wait until morning with wool blankets.

cases.knowledge_need: How quickly spring river rise can undermine a low bank where a timber shed stands.
cases.circumstances: water has reached the shed's lower logs overnight
cases.situation: Tools and seasoned planks remain inside.

cases.knowledge_need: Why wet lime mortar irritates skin and why its setting changes in cold rain.
cases.circumstances: mortar splashed through a torn glove
cases.situation: A small wall joint was laid shortly before rain began.

cases.knowledge_need: How to mend a torn flax net so the repaired section does not pull open under fish weight.
cases.circumstances: tear is beside an old worn knot
cases.situation: The net must be used again at evening.

cases.knowledge_need: How to respond after a child falls through thin shore ice and is pulled out quickly.
cases.circumstances: child is soaked, crying, and shivering in a sharp wind
cases.situation: A heated house is several minutes away.

cases.knowledge_need: Why cream will not rise well in a milk pan left near a smoky warm wall.
cases.circumstances: morning milk was set out after a hot fire was lit
cases.situation: Butter is needed for a market order.

cases.knowledge_need: How lean, wind direction, and binding branches affect where a partially cut birch may fall.
cases.circumstances: tree has begun to settle on the saw cut
cases.situation: A loaded sled and a companion stand within reach of its crown.

cases.knowledge_need: Why a clay cooking pot cracks when set directly from cold water into a strong fire.
cases.circumstances: pot was rinsed in a cold stream moments earlier
cases.situation: Only one pot is available for the group.

cases.knowledge_need: How fresh storm-fallen spruce changes footing, sight lines, and firewood quality in a wet forest.
cases.circumstances: a recent gale has blocked the usual path
cases.situation: Rain is starting and she must choose between detouring or cutting through debris.
